draft.knownFor: American actor, director, and writer known for Ram in Tron, Billy the Kid in Bill & Ted’s Excellent Adventure, and Enoch Emery in Wise Blood.
draft.reveal: Dan Shor first played the Ferengi physician Arridor during the Barzan wormhole negotiations in The Next Generation. Seven years later he returned in Voyager, where the stranded Arridor and Kol had reinvented themselves as holy sages and built a profitable rule over the Takarians.
